title: Israel Bombards Gaza, Days After Trump Announced Deal to Advance Cease-Fire
summary_full: Palestinian officials said at least two people were killed. The deal announced by President Trump calls in part for Hamas to give up its weapons and Israel to stop its attacks in Gaza.
